title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of Law to the Acts of Workers and Other Non-Staff Supervisory Personnel of Supervisory Organs Who Unlawfully Release Persons in Custody or Who, Through Dereliction of Duty, Cause Persons in Custody to Escape

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
March 2, 2001
Interpretation on the Application of Law to the Acts of Releasing Prisoners Without Authorization and Dereliction of Duty
Resulting in Escape of Prisoners by Workers and Other Personnel Who Are Not Regular Supervisory Personnel
of Supervisory Organs
(Adopted by the Ninth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate at its 79th Session
on January 2, 2001)
SPP Interpretation [2001] No. 2
In order to handle according to law criminal cases of releasing prisoners without authorization and criminal cases of dereliction of duty resulting in escape of prisoners, the following interpretation is given as to how to apply law to the acts of releasing prisoners without authorization and dereliction of duty resulting in escape of prisoners by workers and other personnel who are not regular supervisory personnel of supervisory organs:
Where workers and other personnel who are not regular supervisory personnel of supervisory organs, during the process of being employed by the supervisory organ and being entrusted to perform supervisory duties, release prisoners without authorization, they shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of releasing prisoners without authorization according to the provisions of Article 400, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law; where, due to gross negligence, they cause prisoners to escape, resulting in serious consequences, they shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of dereliction of duty resulting in escape of prisoners according to the provisions of Article 400, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law.
